prompt: Two reference images are attached: the first is Hive's real desktop app, whose layout, content, icons, bee mascot and type must stay; the second is Linear's home page, which is the reference for the flat visual language only (hairline dividers, flat fills, tiny quiet metadata, plain text sidebar, no shadows, no glass, no blur, no gradients, no floating rounded cards).
